kjv: For as he (the stingy man) thinketh in his heart, so [is] he
mine: for he (the stingy man) is like one who is inwardly calculating
note: Hebrew kemo-sha'ar benaphsho ken-hu describes the stingy host who reckons the cost of every bite; the KJV wording, often quoted as a general maxim about thought shaping character, is not the sense in context. sha'ar is rare ("reckon, calculate").
Hebrew chetheph (hapax) is best taken as "robber, bandit" (Aramaic/Arabic cognates); the KJV supplies "for" and makes it the prey.
